item.title: Hyogo Top Sightseeing: Himeji Castle, Kobe Harborland & Beyond
item.description: Hyogo Prefecture stretches across an astonishing range of landscapes and histories, from the gleaming white ramparts of Japan’s most celebrated castle to the cosmopolitan harbor districts of Kobe, from sacred mountain temples hidden in cedar forest to the crashing tidal maelstroms of the Seto Inland Sea. Few Japanese prefectures pack such genuine variety into a single itinerary, and fewer still can claim a World Heritage Site, a 19th-century foreign quarter, and a record-breaking suspension bridge all within an hour of each other.
